name: IQLand (Official)
description: IQland MCP provides Automated Intelligence for U.S. real-estate development: parcel & zoning lookup, construction cost, build feasibility, comparable sales, appraisals and property overview and analytics.

_published_faq.name: How do I add IQLand (Official) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add IQLand (Official) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.iqland.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the IQLand (Official) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: IQLand (Official) lists 16 MCP tools, including appraisal, estimate_construction_cost, find_parcel, get_comparable_sales, get_development_kpis, get_highest_resale_plan, get_optimal_build_area, get_parcel_zoning, get_plan, get_property_info, get_zoning_regulations, and health.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to IQLand (Official)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to IQLand (Official) in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
IQLand (Official) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
IQLand (Official) is developed by IQLand. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
